decision.rationale: In the audited seed-42 development readout, mean HR@10 was 0.58375 for the candidate, 0.59475 for the incumbent, and 0.58075 for the scalar control. The candidate missed the preregistered 0.60425 threshold, and eligible_for_confirmation is false. Its 0.003 advantage over the scalar control was small and mixed across categories. Performance selection belongs to the host; these results do not establish the proposed mechanism.
unresolved_explanations: The scalar control also trailed the incumbent by 0.014, so neither learned-scale arm showed an aggregate benefit over the incumbent.
Different gradients, independent training trajectories, checkpoint selection, and category variation could explain the small candidate-control difference.
Host synthetic checks do not document the proposal-specific fixed-state unequal-coordinate contrast or every proposed score and updated-parameter diagnostic.
No independent multi-seed replication or confirmation result was supplied.
